prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Move the sign-in prompt after custom pet picking and photo uploads so users build emotional attachment to their companion before registering. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users early and has high average latency; delaying registration until after pet selection boosts motivation and clarifies why account sync is necessary.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen: Add a dedicated checklist screen explaining desktop hotkeys, how to show/hide the pet, and pet control options before completing setup. (why: Support mailbox received multiple tickets post-onboarding asking how to hide, summon, or talk to the pet once on desktop.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation Wait Time Estimate and Tips: Show explicit time estimates, interactive tip carousel, and readiness notifications while waiting for pet creation. (why: The waiting screen has an average duration of 2336s and 18.7% dropoff due to unguided waiting for pet generation.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Data Preservation Assurance: Add clear microcopy reassuring users that signing in syncs and protects their pet from data loss or accidental resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, notification] Photo Upload Guidelines Warning: Add photo selection tips and formatting requirements on the upload screen to ensure high quality pet rendering. (why: Support received reports that making custom pets fails or results look wrong (3 emails).)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Fast Setup Guarantee: Display time estimate badges and progress indicators on the initial intro story screen. (why: First step loses 23.8% of users immediately; setting clear quick expectations reduces hesitation.)

Addresses post-onboarding support issues, but adding a new screen near completion increases overall friction.
Mitigates high dropoff during extreme generation wait times (mean 2336s) by engaging users during idle time.
